name: semesh
description: Search and invoke the Semesh catalog, inspect deployment readiness, and observe existing deployments. Production source deployment is currently unavailable.

interface.shortDescription: Discover Service Unit Actions and inspect deployment readiness; new source deployment is unavailable.
interface.longDescription: Semesh exposes a Service Unit catalog with nested Actions over MCP/CLI and the intended login, managed-data, and usage-billing deployment contract. Production deployment authorization is currently unavailable: the deployment Platform Action is disabled and source deploy fails closed with deployment_authorization_unavailable before upload, build, payment, publication, or a live URL. Existing deployment records can still be observed.
defaultPrompt: Deploy this app with Semesh, including login, a database, and usage billing.
Find the Semesh Service Unit Action for this task and quote the exact Action input before invoking it.
Turn this agent-built app into a paid product with end-user billing.
